node.description:
__Height__: 195 cm (6'5")

Joseph Joestar begins as a young Englishman in New York, with his grandmother [Erina](https://anilist.co/character/21937). However, an attack by [Straits](https://anilist.co/character/21961) and the disappearance of [Robert Edward O Speedwagon](https://anilist.co/character/21938) soon involve him in the greater chain of events.

__Height:__ 195 cm (6'5")
__Occupation:__ Student, Marine Explorer, Oceanographer
__Nationality:__ Japanese 

Joutarou is Holly Kujo's son and [Joseph Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/6356)'s grandson. In Part 3, he has a recognizable attire of a blue trenchcoat-length school uniform jacket with yellow chains on the collar. He also wears a trademark hat which, while torn in the back, often seems to blend with his hair. When Joutarou first appears, he turned himself in to the police because he believes his Stand is an evil spirit possessing him. After he is released from jail, and learns what his Stand is, Joutarou gets used to Star Platinum -- a fierce, muscular, vaguely Aztec-looking spirit with "the precision of a machine" and the ability to destroy virtually anything with a sledgehammer barrage of fists. He has a very tough exterior, and is even rather rough and delinquent, but he also is very dedicated, intense, and loyal. He is very intelligent, but usually lets his (or Star Platinum's) fists do the talking with the enemy, even though he often has to rely on his wits to deal with stand users' attacks. He is also known for a quick and short temper. His catchphrase is "Yare yare daze." It generally relates of being bored or exasperation. In Part 3, he is the main target of [Dio](https://anilist.co/character/4004), who realizes that Joutarou is his greatest threat.

One of the strongest stands in the JoJo universe; Star Platinum possesses super human senses, strength, stamina, accuracy and speed. It can see for great distances and at great magnifications. The Star tarot card that Star Platinum is named after symbolizes hope. Like other physically powerful stands, Star Platinum suffers from a narrow range of activity. It can only be active within a 2-3 meter radius from Joutarou. ~!It is similar to Dio's The World stand, and, it turns out, can likewise be used to stop time, but that ability is only revealed in Joutarou's epic battle with Dio Brando when Dio was about to drop a steamroller on him.!~

In the sixth story arc Stone Ocean, Joutarou becomes an oceanologist, moves to the United States, eventually marries, and his daughter, [Jolyne](https://anilist.co/character/11222) inherits the potential to wield Stand powers.

__Height:__ 195 cm (6'5")
__Race:__ Human (formerly), Vampire (onwards)
__Nationality:__ British

Dio is an immortal vampire and the arch rival of the Joestar clan.
 
__Series 1: Phantom Blood__ 
~!Dio is the son of [Dario Brando](https://anilist.co/character/74099/Brando-Dario), an alcoholic and abusive father. Back when Dio was just a boy, he was brought into the household of [George Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/21956/Joestar-I-George) after the mysterious death of his father, so as to repay the debt he owed Dio's father for saving his life. But soon Dio's personality caused trouble for George's young son, [Jonathan Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/8087/Joestar-Jonathan). Even more of a sociopath than his father, Dio was resolute to shatter Jonathan's spirit and take his place as the favored son, even going so far as to arrange for Jonathan's dog [Danny](https://anilist.co/character/222601/Danny) to be burned to death. Initially, Dio is able earn the trust of the patriarch of the Joestar family through deceit (and at Jonathan's expense). However, his plans of taking over the Joestar household were discovered by Jonathan when he discovered that not only had Dio poisoned his biological father to death, he was doing the same to his adoptive father, all to take the Joestar estate for his own.

Determined not to be stopped, and understanding the potential to enjoy power over all things instead of just the Joestar estate, Dio wears and activates the Stone Mask, becoming a nearly unstoppable vampire. His gains supernatural abilities such as being able to walk on walls, and regenerating his body faster than fire can consume it. He is able to create two fluid jets from his eyes powerful enough to slice stone and kill living things. He is also able to vaporize his body fluid rapidly enough to freeze anything he touches. However, this is at the expense of having his body be sustained by sheer willpower alone, rather than vital energy. A sufficiently powerful vital force--specifically, sunlight or the Hamon force--will negate the sustaining force's presence and disintegrate the long-unliving body. Like all Jojo vampires, Dio sucks blood through tentacles in his fingers and has been seen at least once drinking blood from an unnamed girl.!~

__Height:__ 178 cm (5'10")
__Stand:__ Hierophant Green

Kakyoin is a high school student and user of the stand Hierophant Green. Unlike most stand users, Kakyoin was born with his stand, though it caused him to feel like an outsider for most of his life due to not knowing any other stand users. Until meeting the rest of the main characters, Hierophant was Kakyoin’s only real friend.

Hierophant is not physically strong, but is elastic and can able to unravel into tentacles which can capture opponents. It can also enter an enemy’s body to possess them, though Kakyoin rarely uses this ability. Hierophant’s signature power is emerald splash, which hurls emeralds that slice opponents.

Kakyoin remains calm and collected even in dangerous situations, and is good at seeing through opponents’ strategies. 

During a trip to Egypt with his family, he encountered [Dio](https://anilist.co/character/4004/Brando-Dio), who controlled him using a flesh bud. It was later removed by [Jotaro](https://anilist.co/character/4003/Kuujou-Joutarou) and Kakyoin joined the Joestar group.

__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")

Jean-Pierre Polnareff is a Frenchman who joins the Joestar group on their journey to Egypt after being freed from Dio's control by the group. He aims to avenge the murder of his sister. His brash nature and overconfidence combined with his general tomfoolery is often the source of trouble throughout the journey, and other members of the group often remark on his tendency to endanger himself and others.

~!Polnareff reappears in 2001 (Part 5), now 36 years old and wheelchair-bound, to assist [Giorno](https://anilist.co/character/10529/Giovanna-Giorno) and the rest of Passione in their fight against the boss.!~

He also serves as the inspiration for many characters in other franchises such as [Guile](https://anilist.co/character/9312/Guile) (Street Fighter), [Paul](https://anilist.co/character/285435/Phoenix-Paul) (Tekken), [Benimaru Nikaido](https://anilist.co/character/61203/Nikaido-Benimaru) (King of Fighters).

Born the unique son of the wealthy businessman [George Joestar I](https://anilist.co/character/21956), Jonathan is an honest, kind, and positive man whose life is fraught with tragedy after meeting his adopted older brother - and series antagonist - [Dio Brando](https://anilist.co/character/4004). In his battle against Dio, Jonathan becomes a Ripple user under the tutelage of the master [Will Anthonio Zeppeli](https://anilist.co/character/18062).

**Part 5:**~!Jonathan is the biological father of [Giorno Giovanna](https://anilist.co/character/10529), the protagonist of Vento Aureo, as well as a handful of other illegitimate offspring.!~

node.description:
__Height:__ 188 cm (6'2")
__Stand:__ Magician's Red

Avdol is a fortune teller and friend of [Joseph Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/6356/Joestar-Joseph). They met three years before the events of the story. He was born with a stand, Magician’s Red, which controls fire. This stand’s abilities include Crossfire Hurricane, which shoots fire in the shape of an Ankh, and Crossfire Hurricane Special, which splits into multiple Ankh-shaped flames. He can also create flame tracker that detects a person’s energy.

Avdol presents himself as a serious person but can sometimes let his emotions get the best of him. He often acts as the voice of reason among the Joestar group and exhibits strong loyalty by frequently placing himself in danger to protect his friends. He is knowledgeable about geography and stands, enjoys India’s chaotic atmosphere, and respects [Polnareff](https://anilist.co/character/4368/Polnareff-JeanPierre)'s chivalrous attitude that he displayed when they first met. Avdol gives [Jotaro](https://anilist.co/character/4003/Kuujou-Joutarou)'s stand its name. 

~!Avdol encountered [DIO](https://anilist.co/character/4004/Brando-Dio) in Egypt before the main events of the story, but was able to escape unscathed.!~

~!At one point he is shot by [Hol Horse](https://anilist.co/character/16557/Horse-Hol) and presumed dead, but he was actually in hiding and rejoins the Joestar group later. He is killed protecting Polnareff and [Iggy](https://anilist.co/character/21089/Iggy) from [Vanilla Ice](https://anilist.co/character/76658/Ice-Vanilla).!~

He is named after Paula Abdul.

__Height:__ 33.3 cm
__Nationality:__ American

Iggy is a boston terrier who wields a stand known as The Fool, which is able to manipulate sand. Since The Fool is made of sand, damaging it will not hurt Iggy. He creates various objects out of sand including the wings of a glider and a statue of DIO. Iggy is depicted as rude and disobedient, as shown by his tendency to chew on people’s hair while farting on them. He loves coffee-flavored gum.

Iggy was previously owned by a rich man, but he ran away and became a stray in New York. Avdol caught him and brought him to Egypt to help the Joestar group defeat DIO. He frequently chews Polnareff’s hair and once put chewed gum inside Jotaro’s hat.

~!At first, Iggy seems indifferent towards the Joestar’s quest to defeat DIO. Then he accidentally finds DIO’s mansion and is attacked and injured by Pet Shop, causing his hatred for DIO to grow. He is killed after saving Polnareff from Vanilla Ice.!~

He was initially drawn as realistic dog, but as the story progressed, his face gradually became more similar to a human’s. He is named after Iggy Pop.

**Height**: 188cm *(anime)*

Hol Horse is a minor antagonist in JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stardust Crusaders (first seen in Chapter 141 and Episode 10), as well as one of the main characters of Crazy Diamond's Demonic Heartbreak. He is a tall, blonde-haired cowboy-themed mercenary, serving under Dio and his army of other Stand Users. He considers himself "The #2", preferring to work as support with a partner due to his cowardice and caution. He also respects women, no matter how pretty, or how ugly, as seen with his ex, Nena. 

His Stand is Emperor, named after the Tarot Card of the same name. It manifests itself as a retro-futuristic pistol, which functions as a normal firearm, although the bullets are able to change their trajectory to Hol Horse's command.

~!He is seemingly fatally injured by his own Stand's bullets in Chapter 221 (and episode 37 of the anime), but manages to survive and go into hiding, fearing Dio's punishment for failing his mission of killing the Joestar group.!~

__Height:__ 168 cm 

The female assistant to Lisa Lisa. Suzie Q is a slightly ditzy girl who worries for her friends. Evidently this carefree personality has not diminished even in the events of Stardust Crusaders, when she is shown enthusiastically recording her sightings in Japan on a camcorder when on a trip to see her daughter.   ~!She is introduced as the female assistant to Lisa Lisa. When she first appears, she is taken over by the remains of Esidisi and attacks her friends. Thanks to a combination attack by Caesar and Joseph, she is saved with only minor injury. She marries Joseph in 1939.!~

node.description:
__Occupation:__ Gambler
__Stand:__ Osiris
__Manga Debut:__ Chapter 211
__Anime Debut:__ Episode 34

D'Arby is an expert and inveterate gambler and his Stand, Osiris, can steal souls. He is a member of the Egypt 9 Glory Gods and meets the Joestar Group in Cairo. Here, he tricks them into wagering their souls in various gambles. D'Arby is also Telence T. D'Arby's older brother.

Daniel J. D'Arby exhibits an affable but sly, knowing character. D'Arby first and foremost character trait is his love of gambling. He states that he lives for the thrill of gambling (which he recognizes as worthless). This love of gambling is complemented by his enjoyment for cheating, and he proudly admits that cheating is one of his greatest skills shamelessly rigging every game he's seen participating to while justifying himself by claiming that if the cheat isn't exposed, it is "fair" game.
Mariah is one of the Egypt 9 Glory Gods. She separates the group in Luxor and attempts to take out Joseph and Avdol using her Stand, Bastet, while Alessi confronts the rest of the heroes.

Boingo is a young Stand User whose Stand is Tohth. As part of the Egypt 9 Glory Gods, he attempts to assassinate the Joestar Group in Egypt alongside his older brother Oingo and later Hol Horse. Boingo is a young child of ordinary build, but his characteristics include an unusually large mouth and a large afro held together by a topless cap, leaving a few stray hair locks. His attire consists of a bright shirt and trousers over which he wears shorts and a jacket, plus a coat and simple shoes.

Tohth is an Artificial Non-Humanoid Stand that takes the form of a manga. The book, titled, Oingo Boingo Brothers Adventure, will show predictions of the future. When an image appears, the prediction(s) then become fate and are destined to come to fruition. However, nobody, not even Boingo, can control the Image projected onto Tohth.
Holly Kuujou née Joestar is the daughter of [Joseph Joestar](https://anilist.co/character/6356/) and mother of [Joutarou Kuujou](https://anilist.co/character/4003/).

Vanilla Ice is the last Vampire created by DIO and one of the penultimate Stand Users the Joestar Group faces upon infiltrating DIO's Mansion. After the group is split up, he is sent to take out the team consisting of Avdol, Polnareff, and Iggy. Vanilla Ice is a Stand User controlling his void-based Stand ability, Cream, to battle.

His name is based off the famous ''rapper'', Vanilla Ice. His stand is named after the band, Cream.

N'Doul is a man of athletic build and medium height, keeping unkempt dark hair and whose blank eyes are always near shut due to his blindness. He wears a simple T-shirt over which he keeps a stripped overshirt and a drape to protect himself from the sun. N'Doul also wears armbands and simple trousers and shoes. He wears a headband and two earrings which look like bracelets.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

node.description:
__Nationality:__ American
__Occupation:__ Butler
__Stand:__ Atum

D'Arby is one of the Egypt 9 Glory Gods and resides in DIO's mansion in Cairo acting as his butler. He isolates and challenges Jotaro, Joseph and Kakyoin when the Joestar Group enters the mansion and forces them into waging their souls against him in various video game challenges. He is also Daniel J. D'arby's younger brother.

As a butler, Terence is a mannerly individual. However, his demeanor is a facade for his twisted and arrogant personality. Due to his occupation, Terence is rather polite and affable, keeping his calm even in the face of provocations and comes to greet and confront the Joestar Group when they enter DIO's Mansion. Terence is a very intelligent man and is especially proficient at video games: He defeated the likes of Tatsuhiko, a child genius with an IQ of 190, albeit without the use of his Stand's ability to read minds.

Oingo is a minor antagonist appearing in Stardust Crusaders.

As a part of the Egypt 9 Glory Gods, he attempts to assassinate the Joestar Group alongside his little brother Boingo. His Stand is Khnum, which allows him to disguise himself as anyone.

Pet Shop serves as the guard of Dio Brando's mansion in Egypt. It ruthlessly kills any who may trespass or it deems as suspicious. When it first appeared, Pet Shop decapitates two large dogs with ease and smashes a beggar (employed by Abdul to find Dio's mansion) and his car with his stand. Pet Shop possesses incredible aerial agility and the ability to swim.   ~!Ultimately, Pet Shop is defeated by Iggy, but is able to severely injure him by severing his leg in the process.!~  (Source: JJBA wiki)

Anubis is a minor antagonist featured in Stardust Crusaders. It's unique in being a userless Stand who can possess anyone who wields it, and repeatedly tries to kill the Joestar Group's members in Egypt.

Enya Geil is one of Dio's most loyal supporters, and the one who originally gave him the Stand Arrow, which she obtained from Diavolo. She is the mother of J. Geil. Her stand is Justice, which is able to control people through their wounds, whether alive or dead.  For legal reasons, her name is changed in the American version of both the game and the manga, to N-Yah Gail and Enyaba Geil respectively.  In the OVA:  ~!She is able to change her appearance from that of a young woman to an old lady at will. No explanation as to why is ever given.!~
A kind young woman, she nurtures a de-aged Jean Pierre Polnareff after he's injured from his fight against Alessi.
Roses is the butler of Joseph Joestar and Suzi Q, also acting as the latter's personal chauffeur and bodyguard.
Alessi is one of the Egypt 9 Glory Gods and attempts to assassinate Polnareff in Luxor as Mariah battles Joseph and Avdol. His Stand is Sethan, a rejuvenating shadow.

name.native: ウィルソン・フィリップス

node.description:
Wilson Phillips is a minor character featured in Stardust Crusaders.
Despite being a powerful American Senator, DIO hijacks his car and forces Wilson Phillips to become his chauffeur in order to pursue the Joestar Group in the streets of Cairo.
Chaka is an Egyptian farmer who found Anubis in a pile of rubble and got possessed, prompting him to go battle Polnareff.
Khan is an ordinary barber and is possessed by Anubis as he gives Polnareff a shave. Consequently, he battles both Polnareff and Jotaro.

Nukesaku is a minor antagonist featured in Part III: Stardust Crusaders. He is a henchman of Dio Brando and one of the last vampires in the manga. He apparently suffers abuse from the rest of Dio's allies, being treated as a burden due to his (lack of) power. His stand, The Idiot, is named after an album by Iggy Pop.   ~!After his comrades are defeated, Nukesaku attempts to use his ability to defeat Jotaro and company, but is quickly and effortlessly dispatched by them when they discover that his thumbs point in the opposite direction when he is clasping his hands. He is forced to lead the group to Dio and believes that Dio will use this opportunity to defeat the Joestars, but when he removes the lid of his master's coffin, finds himself killed and sectioned to pieces in the coffin instead.!~  (Source: JJBA Wikia)

__Stand:__ Tenore Sax

Kenny G. is a minor antagonist featured in Stardust Crusaders. When the Joestar Group enters DIO's Mansion, he casts an illusion on it to make it look like a labyrinth to them but is quickly taken out.
